failed_run.cold: Both providers built and verified their output images successfully
failed_run.warm: Both providers failed in scope selection before building
failed_run.cause: The generated wrapper exposed neither the cache_scope input nor output, and the shared workflow omitted the cold-to-warm handoff. With no series ID, the warm action correctly rejected an empty published scope.
failed_run.storage: BoringCache storage was unmeasured. The reporter invoked check --exact, which this CLI rejects. Missing storage remains unmeasured; it is not zero.

qualification_plan.purpose: Exercise the canary handoff without a series ID and the supported CLI storage probe
qualification_plan.timed_scope: The unchanged case definition: Docker build including export/load and measured provider setup, excluding output inspection
acceptance: Both cold jobs export the same nonempty scope
Both warm jobs receive the cold scope and execute their builds
Every phase verifies its loaded output image
BoringCache warm consumption remains restore-only and requires a cache hit
The storage probe uses supported CLI arguments; absent byte measurements remain unmeasured
Final product evidence and all job conclusions are preserved
qualification_plan.limits: This deliberately omits a series ID to exercise the failing canary path. It is a diagnostic, not a publication series or a performance claim. The full local regression also exercises both providers with the combined variant and preserves legacy missing-scope rejection.
